    query_tokens = [t for t in tokens(query) if t not in STOPWORDS]
    
    # Apply expansions
    expanded = set(query_tokens)
    for t in query_tokens:
        if t in EXPANSIONS:
            expanded.update(EXPANSIONS[t])
    
    # Determine broad terms to downweight
    downweighted = set()
    for specific, broads in BROAD_TERMS.items():

            downweighted.update(broads)
    
    # Compute IDF for rarity
    N = len(chunks)

        scored.append((score, i, c))
